verdict.rationale: Trivy's official CLI is its primary, extensively documented interface (e.g. `trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig`, `trivy k8s --report summary`), installable via standard channels (brew, docker) and corroborated by community users praising its ease of CI/automation use. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of CLI flags/output modes tailored specifically for AI-agent consumption (e.g. structured machine-readable prompts beyond generic JSON).
